steps.name: 편집기 로드 · 표 요소 선택
steps.js: let b=null; for(let i=0;i<20&&!b;i++){ b=document.querySelector('[data-sel="e01"]'); if(!b){ document.body.click(); const p=document.querySelector('[data-tab="props"]'); if(p) p.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } } if(!b) return 'no list'; b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); return !!document.querySelector('[data-tblop]') ? true : 'no tblop buttons'

steps.name: ＋행 → 3×2
steps.js: document.querySelector('[data-tblop="row+"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const t=document.querySelector('[data-tblop]').parentElement.querySelector('.hint').textContent.trim(); return t==='3×2' ? true : t

steps.name: ＋열 → 3×3 · colW 3개
steps.js: document.querySelector('[data-tblop="col+"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const t=document.querySelector('[data-tblop]').parentElement.querySelector('.hint').textContent.trim(); const cw=document.querySelector('input[data-list="colW"]').value.split(',').length; return t==='3×3' && cw===3 ? true : t+' colW='+cw

steps.name: －열·－행 → 2×2
steps.js: document.querySelector('[data-tblop="col-"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); document.querySelector('[data-tblop="row-"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const t=document.querySelector('[data-tblop]').parentElement.querySelector('.hint').textContent.trim(); return t==='2×2' ? true : t

steps.name: －행 은 2행 아래로 안 줄어듦
steps.js: document.querySelector('[data-tblop="row-"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const t=document.querySelector('[data-tblop]').parentElement.querySelector('.hint').textContent.trim(); return t==='2×2' ? true : t

steps.name: 글머리 요소 선택 → 감지 스위치(켬)
steps.js: document.querySelector('[data-sel="e02"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const sg=document.querySelector('.seg[data-k="autoNum"]'); return sg && sg.querySelector('button.on').dataset.v==='on' ? true : 'seg='+(sg&&sg.innerHTML)

steps.name: 끔 → 글머리가 ● 로(번호 글자 유지)
steps.js: document.querySelector('.seg[data-k="autoNum"] [data-v="off"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const el=[...document.querySelectorAll('#stage .rs-el')].find(e=>e.dataset.type==='bullets'); const bu=el.querySelector('.rs-bu').textContent; const on=document.querySelector('.seg[data-k="autoNum"] button.on').dataset.v; return bu==='●' && on==='off' ? true : 'bu='+bu+' on='+on

steps.name: 켬 → 번호 글머리 복귀
steps.js: document.querySelector('.seg[data-k="autoNum"] [data-v="on"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const el=[...document.querySelectorAll('#stage .rs-el')].find(e=>e.dataset.type==='bullets'); const bu=el.querySelector('.rs-bu').textContent; return bu==='1.' ? true : 'bu='+bu
